title.value: An Act concerning Environment - Playground Surfacing Materials - Prohibitions
title.provenance: AN ACT concerning 1 Environment - Playground Surfacing Materials - Prohibitions 2

location.provenance: By: Delegates Guyton, Lehman, Allen, Ebersole, Forbes, Holmes, Pasteur, Ruth, and Stein Introduced and read first time: February 7, 2024 Assigned to: Environment and Transportation

status.provenance: FOR the purpose of prohibiting, on or after a certain date, a person from using, supplying, selling, soliciting, or offering for sale playground surfacing materials that contain certain concentrations of certain chemicals for the construction or renovation of the ground surface of a playground in the State

date.provenance: SECTION 2. AND BE IT FURTHER ENACTED, That this Act shall take effect October 1, 2024.

pfas_definition.provenance: PFAS' MEANS PER- AND POLYFLUOROALKYL SUBSTANCES. (C) 'PFAS' MEANS PER- AND POLYFLUOROALKYL SUBSTANCES. - (D) 'PLAYGROUND' MEANS A PUBLIC OUTDOOR RECREATION AREA FOR CHILDREN EQUIPPED WITH ONE OR MORE PLAY STRUCTURES. - (E) 'PLAYGROUND SURFACING MATERIALS' MEANS PRODUCTS, MATERIALS, OR SUBSTANCES USED OR INSTALLED ON THE GROUND SURFACE OF A PLAYGROUND IN THE STATE.

type.provenance: ON OR AFTER OCTOBER 1, 2024, A PERSON MAY NOT USE, SUPPLY, SELL, SOLICIT, OR OFFER FOR SALE IN THE STATE PLAYGROUND SURFACING MATERIALS THAT CONTAIN: (2) FLUORINATED ORGANIC CHEMICALS THAT CONTAIN AT LEAST 1 FULLY FLUORINATED CARBON ATOM, INCLUDING PFAS SUBSTANCES; AND

date.provenance: SECTION 2. AND BE IT FURTHER ENACTED, That this Act shall take effect October 1, 2024.
